new.name: IDENTIFIES_PERFORMANCE_BOTTLENECK
new.definition: The reasoning localizes the dominant share of a measured runtime to a specific stage or component of the execution pipeline, using timing evidence, so that this stage becomes the target of optimization.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text attributing most of the measured runtime to a specific stage or component.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning references a measured runtime or timing breakdown.
The reasoning attributes the dominant cost to an identifiable stage or component rather than to the whole system in general.
The identified bottleneck is presented as the reason to redesign or optimize that stage.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning states only that performance is inadequate without locating a dominant cost.
The reasoning proposes optimizations unrelated to any identified cost contributor.

uncertain.name: ATTRIBUTES_DISCREPANCY_TO_MEASUREMENT_ARTIFACT
uncertain.definition: The reasoning explains an observed numerical mismatch or apparent failure as an artifact of the measurement or reference computation (e.g., its precision, scale, or summation order) rather than as a defect in the evaluated implementation.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text attributing the discrepancy to the measurement or reference rather than to the implementation.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning acknowledges a specific observed discrepancy or failed comparison.
The reasoning provides a causal explanation identifying a property of the measurement, reference value, or comparison method as the source of the discrepancy.
The reasoning distinguishes that cause from a fault in the evaluated implementation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning attributes the failure to an actual defect in the implementation.
The reasoning merely repeats the discrepancy or expresses confusion without a causal explanation.
The reasoning speculates about an environmental cause without any identifiable supporting property of the measurement.

uncertain.name: IMPLEMENTS_DECISION_IN_ARTIFACT
uncertain.definition: An artifact-writing action produces content that embodies a design decision or approach previously specified in reasoning, with traceable correspondence between the described design and the written artifact.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning specifying the design or approach to be realized.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action that writes the artifact realizing that design.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies an identifiable design decision, structure, or approach.
The action writes or rewrites an artifact whose content reflects that specified design rather than an unrelated change.
exclusion_conditions: The written artifact does not correspond to the design described in the reasoning.
The reasoning only describes a problem without specifying a design that the action could realize.

uncertain.name: SUBSTITUTES_EQUIVALENT_MEANS_AFTER_TOOL_FAILURE
uncertain.definition: After an observation reports that an attempted tool, command, or facility is unavailable or errored, a subsequent action pursues the same informational or functional goal through a different tool or mechanism.

parameters.name: failure_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the attempted tool or command was unavailable or failed.

parameters.name: substitute_action
parameters.description: The action achieving the same goal through an alternative tool or mechanism.

assertion_conditions: The observation indicates the attempted operation could not be performed (e.g., tool or command not found, error result).
The substitute action targets the same goal that the failed operation was meant to achieve, using a different tool, command, or data source.
exclusion_conditions: The observation reports success, so no substitution is needed.
The substitute action addresses a different goal than the failed operation.
